title: System colours only, and richer social cards
description: Author's direction 2026-09-23: (1) remove the light/dark toggle; the site follows the system colour scheme only (prefers-color-scheme), with no stored override. (2) Social cards always render in light mode. (3) Engine cards show the engine's spider chart (severity colours and shape per BD-d5d1a0), not a single big number. (4) Leaderboard-style cards (home, dimension, group, question) show the ranking as a horizontal bar chart of engines, most biased at the top, with the floor marked, rather than one big number. Cell cards may keep a big number with its interval. All cards keep the phone-feed legibility rules in docs/social-cards.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: System colours and chart cards
  Scenario: No theme toggle
    Given any page
    Then there is no light/dark control and the page follows the operating system's colour scheme
  Scenario: Cards are light
    Given any social card
    Then it is rendered in the light palette regardless of the build machine or viewer
  Scenario: Engine cards show the spider
    Given an engine's social card
    Then it shows that engine's spider chart across dimensions with its overall rank
  Scenario: Board cards show bars
    Given the home, a dimension, a group or a question card
    Then it shows a horizontal bar chart of engines ranked most biased first with the floor marked

right_now_summary: The site now follows system colours, while social cards use light mode and show charts instead of single scores.
